### section-echo | kinds=read | flags= | sections=LOGS
echo "=== LOGS ==="; journalctl -u nginx --no-pager

### section-printf | kinds=read | flags= | sections=DISK
printf -- "--- DISK ---\n"; df -h

### section-two | kinds=read | flags= | sections=DISK,LOGS
echo "=== DISK ==="; echo "=== LOGS ==="; journalctl -u nginx

### section-echo-plain | kinds=read,write | flags=
echo "restarting nginx"; systemctl restart nginx

### section-dashes-only | kinds=read | flags=
echo "-----"

### section-with-eq | kinds=read | flags=
echo "=== A=B ==="

### section-script | kinds=read,read,write,read | flags= | sections=DISK,MEM
echo "=== DISK ==="
df -h /
echo "=== MEM ==="
free -h
systemctl restart nginx
uptime
